nodes.label: env (validated environment schema)
nodes.rationale: emptyStringAsUndefined is enabled because Zod would otherwise treat an empty string (e.g. `PORT=` in .env) as a type mismatch and would never apply defaults for empty string values. clientPrefix 'VITE_' is enforced at both type-level and runtime so client-exposed vars cannot leak server secrets. runtimeEnv is import.meta.env because the app is Vite-based rather than Node process.env based.
